meta.description: Analyze single-cell ATAC-seq with Signac/ArchR (R) and SnapATAC2 (Python alternative), including QC, TF-IDF/LSI, differential accessibility, and chromVAR motif deviation analysis.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: Numerical results are traced to the labeled synthetic audit object; direct answers do not invent biological results.

practice_boundaries.detail: The adversarial response rejects causal single-TF claims and QC bypasses.

methodological_ground.detail: The audit executed data-derived LSI depth filtering, depth-adjusted DA, and GC/accessibility-matched chromVAR deviations.

code_usability.detail: The documented isolated WSL/Linux route invoked the exact source chromVAR script twice and both processes exited zero; output artifacts were byte-identical.

functional_suitability.note: The central Signac workflow, scale-routing table, depth-aware DA, and chromVAR procedure are coherent and current for the supported route.

reliability.note: Seeded backgrounds, SerialParam, explicit WSL escape hatch, and clean reruns are strong; deprecated QC calls remain a documented environmental constraint.

performance_context.note: The Skill identifies in-memory Signac limits and separates ArchR/SnapATAC2 large-scale routes.

agent_usability.note: Triggers, version checks, decision tables, common errors, and exact command contract are actionable.

human_usability.note: The workflow and interpretation limits are readable and scoped.

security.note: No credential handling, destructive operations, or raw untrusted-code execution was found.

maintainability.note: The focused chromVAR script is parsed, deterministic, and relies on the activated runtime rather than an audit-machine path.

agent_specific.note: Methodological stop conditions are excellent; large alternative frameworks are documented but not end-to-end exercised in this chromVAR-only private runtime.

key_strengths: The exact source chromVAR script has now been independently proven on its documented isolated WSL/Linux route with two natural zero exits and byte-identical artifacts.
The executable Signac checks verify data-derived removal of two depth-correlated LSI components and depth-adjusted logistic-regression DA.
The Skill makes strong methodological boundaries explicit for peak-set circularity, motif interpretation, gene activity, and QC.
All direct-response formal inputs are recorded, validated, and do not overclaim unavailable execution.

recommendations.title: Keep the isolated-runtime prerequisite prominent
recommendations.problem: The Windows native Signac teardown remains unsuitable even though the documented WSL path is clean.
recommendations.root_cause: This is a host-runtime limitation outside the portable source script.
recommendations.fix: Retain the current WSL/Linux route and expand it only if a future supported native Windows runtime is independently shown to exit cleanly.

recommendations.title: Track future ATACqc migration separately
recommendations.problem: The example retains deprecated NucleosomeSignal and TSSEnrichment calls while fragtk is absent.
recommendations.root_cause: ATACqc requires the external fragtk binary and is not a drop-in replacement.
recommendations.fix: When fragtk is available in a supported environment, add a dedicated compatibility-tested ATACqc example without changing current documented behavior prematurely.
